about_the_game:
Gun Dealer is a tense and atmospheric simulator where you step into the shoes of a secretive arms trader. Build your reputation, expand your inventory, and make dangerous deals with a variety of clients — from small-time buyers to powerful organizations. Every transaction is a risk, and every decision could be your last.

Negotiate prices, source rare weapons, upgrade your hidden workshop, and manage your growing network of contacts. But be careful — the authorities are always watching. Keep a low profile, move your goods wisely, and trust no one.

Will you rise to dominate the world of underground arms dealing, or will you be taken down before you reach the top?

Features:
🔸 Trade a wide range of firearms, upgrades, and equipment
🔸 Balance profit and risk while dealing with unpredictable clients
🔸 Upgrade your shop, expand your influence, and unlock new opportunities
🔸 Handle inspections, bribes, and unexpected raids
🔸 Atmospheric low-poly visuals with a dark, gritty tone

Prepare to deal, survive, and dominate. In this world, every bullet counts.

content_descriptors.notes: This game depicts illegal arms trading and criminal activities. It does not contain explicit violence, drug use, or sexual content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
